observations: Photo 0 shows a single grid-tied style solar panel (rectangular, black cells with white grid lines).
No visible wattage rating, model number, brand name, or label/serial on the panel face in the photo.
A watermark text is visible on the image, but it does not clearly identify the panel model.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: Only a solar panel is shown (photo 0). No battery photo, capacity rating, or runtime test is shown.
No battery or internal inspection photos are provided; only photo 0 of a panel.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: This is generic marketing text; it does not specify the exact kit contents or ratings.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/brand/model is not readable, so the item may not match the comparable prices (e.g., 300W vs 400W vs 600W).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label/spec sticker showing brand, model, and rated wattage (W), plus an image of the back label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case match among the comparables (assume the lowest-wattage/lowest-value panel in the list).

risks.risk: The listing text mentions a battery, but no battery is shown—could be missing or not included.
risks.proof: Photos of the battery (front label with voltage/Ah, brand, and date), and a photo showing the full set included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as solar panel only (battery treated as not included).

risks.risk: Battery runtime claim (8 hours) may be overstated or depends on load/inverter settings.
risks.proof: A short video/clip of a load test: battery connected to inverter + a stated load (e.g., bulbs/fan rating) with runtime timer, and battery capacity label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (assume battery performance is unknown/possibly lower).

risks.risk: Panel condition (new vs used, microcracks, delamination) cannot be confirmed from one photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cell surfaces and frame corners, plus a photo of any damage and the backsheet condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition (not guaranteed new).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the panel’s specification label (brand + model + rated wattage in W).
Send photos of the battery (label showing voltage and Ah, brand, and whether it’s new).
Send a photo showing the complete package contents (panel + battery + any controller/inverter/cables included).
Send a short runtime test clip showing the battery powering a stated load for the claimed duration.
response.reason: The photo shows a solar panel but the key pricing driver (rated wattage/brand/model) is not readable, and the battery claims are not verifiable because no battery is shown. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the comparables.
